question: As of 2024-12-01, which known security vulnerabilities affect jinja2==3.1.2 and urllib3==1.26.15 (PyPI)? List every advisory with its identifiers (GHSA, CVE, PYSEC) and the first fixed version.

claims.text: PYSEC-2023-192 (CVE-2023-43804) for urllib3 is fixed in 1.26.17 on the 1.26 line.
PYSEC-2023-192 (CVE-2023-43804) for urllib3 is fixed in 2.0.6 on the 2.x line.
PYSEC-2023-212 (CVE-2023-45803) for urllib3 is fixed in 1.26.18 on the 1.26 line.
PYSEC-2023-212 (CVE-2023-45803) for urllib3 is fixed in 2.0.7 on the 2.x line.
Verdict: GHSA-g3rq-g295-4j3m (CVE-2020-28493), stated as < 2.11.3, does not affect jinja2 3.1.2; established.
Verdict: GHSA-5phf-pp7p-vc2r (CVE-2021-28363), stated as >= 1.26.0, < 1.26.4, does not affect urllib3 1.26.15; established.

conclusion: Two urllib3 advisories (PYSEC-2023-192, fixed in 1.26.17; PYSEC-2023-212, fixed in 1.26.18) are documented for urllib3 1.26.15; three further advisories returned for the pinned versions could not be verified because their records are masked; older advisories are ruled out by their stated ranges.
